text.tspan: Property lookup walks UP the chain and stops at the first match. class builds exactly this.
d.eat() → not on the instance → not on Dog.prototype → FOUND on Animal.prototype.
d.speak() → found on Dog.prototype first, so Animal's speak() is shadowed, never reached.
class Dog extends Animal builds this chain for you: extends sets the link, super() runs the parent
constructor, and instanceof asks whether a given prototype appears anywhere along the chain.
